name: Farm Fury Cannonfire
subtitle: Launch animals, topple robots
promotionalText: Load the cannon, aim and fire! Launch eight farm animals at wobbly robot towers across 160 levels in nine worlds and take the farm back from the Harvest Robots.
description:
The Harvest Robots have built their towers all over the farm. Time to load the cannon!

Farm Fury Cannonfire is a physics destruction game. Pick your team of farm animals, drag back to aim, and launch them at wobbly robot fortresses. Knock out the supports, send the towers crashing down and clear every robot to win.

EIGHT ANIMALS, EIGHT ABILITIES
Tap mid-flight to unleash each animal's power:
- Cluck scatters a cluster of eggs
- Bessie slams the ground with a shockwave
- Percy curls into a ball and dives in
- Woolly throws bouncy wool balls
- Ducky fires spinning water swirls
- Horace hurls heavy horseshoes
- Gerald drops feather bombs
- Billy slings a splattering mud ball

Start with Cluck and Bessie, and release new animals as you clear levels. Choose three for each level, and switch them between shots.

160 LEVELS, NINE WORLDS
Meadow Ruins, Frozen Tundra, Watermill Village, Sky Islands, Sunken City and the Robot Mothership, plus three bonus worlds available to buy: Dustbowl Canyon, Harvest Fairground and Crop Factory. Every world has its own cannon, its own crazy robot-built towers, contraptions like sunflowers, cranes and rolling boulders, and two stages in every level.

BEAT THE BOSSES
Each world ends with a boss that drops in from the robot mothership to defend its keep.

EARN THREE STARS
Clear every robot with animals to spare for a three-star finish, and beat your own best scores on the leaderboard.

MAKE IT YOURS
Fire in style with golden, pumpkin and tractor cannon skins, colourful flight trails and impact effects like confetti, popcorn and fireworks.

Farm Fury Cannonfire is free to download. It contains ads and optional in-app purchases, including bonus worlds, coins, cosmetics and ad removal. Purchases and links out of the game are protected by a parental gate. No account needed, and your progress stays on your device.

1. PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
Farm Fury Cannonfire is a physics puzzle game for children and families (ages 9+, matching the age rating). The player launches farm animals from a cannon at towers built by robots, toppling them to defeat the robots, across 160 levels in 9 worlds. It is offline single-player entertainment that builds planning and cause-and-effect reasoning, with very little reading required.

2. HOW TO ACCESS THE FEATURES
No account, login or sign-up exists. Tap the title screen > Play > choose a world > choose a level > pick three animals > Play. Drag back from the cannon to aim and release to fire; tap the screen during a flight to use the animal's ability. Six story worlds are free; each unlocks by beating the previous world's boss. New animals are released by clearing levels.
Paid content: the settings cog on the menu screen > Shop. Every purchase and every link out of the app (Privacy Policy, Terms, our merchandise store, and the App Store pages of our other Farm Fury games) is behind a parental gate (a simple arithmetic question). Restore Purchases is on the Shop's Coins page. In-app purchases (attached to this version): Remove Ads, four coin packs (consumable), cosmetics (5 cannon skins, 6 flight trails, 5 impact effects), and three bonus worlds (Dustbowl Canyon, Harvest Fairground, Crop Factory). Cosmetics can also be bought with coins earned by playing.
No user-generated content, chat or social features. The leaderboard shows the player's own records from this device only.

3. EXTERNAL SERVICES
- Apple In-App Purchase (StoreKit, through Unity IAP) for all payments.
- Unity LevelPlay ad mediation with Google AdMob and Unity Ads, configured as child-directed (no personalised ads, no advertising identifier, no tracking prompt). Ads: an occasional interstitial between levels, a banner on the pause and level-failed screens, and optional rewarded videos (an extra animal after a loss, double coins). Remove Ads turns off all non-optional ads.
- Unity Gaming Services Analytics for anonymous gameplay events (level start/complete/fail, purchases, ads shown).
Progress is saved on the device only.

4. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
None. The app works the same in all regions; only the store prices are localised by Apple.

5. REGULATED INDUSTRY / THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL
Not applicable. All characters, art and music are original to Tenbucks Mobile's Farm Fury series or licensed for commercial use.
